title: How the admin desk is composed
question: The bag-label world stays. The roll picked a find-first ledger so scanning stays as fast as today’s table. Lock a composition, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Find-first clipboard
options.lineage: Shop inventory clipboard with a pinned find strip
options.thesis: Search owns the first viewport; cafes stay a dense ink ledger you can scan like the table you have now.
options.viewport: Teal nav rail. Cafes title and orange Add cafe. A full-width find field. Status tabs as printed marks. Then a compact ledger of name, status word, address, updated, Edit, Unpublish.
options.risk: On a short laptop screen the ledger starts lower than today’s table, so the find strip has to stay one line.

raised.raise: Each ledger row reads as an end-label: name, status word, origin — not a dump of spreadsheet cells.
Status is an ink word with a hairline, never a pill.
Unpublish cancels a listing the way a VOID stamp cancels a coupon, instead of a second outline button competing with Edit.
One shared ledger grid holds every cafe; cards are only the narrow-phone fallback.

options.label: Pending rail + ledger
options.lineage: Back-of-house ticket rail over an approved ledger
options.thesis: Today’s work sits on a short pending rail; the approved catalog stays a dense ledger underneath.
options.viewport: Nav rail. Title and Add cafe. A horizontal rail of pending names. Under it, the same compact approved ledger with search and status tabs.
options.risk: All is two places at once, so finding an approved cafe is still fast, but pending work can steal the first glance.

options.label: Status columns
options.thesis: Approved, pending, and rejected sit in three label columns you scan sideways.
options.viewport: Nav rail. Title and Add cafe. Find across the top. Three equal columns of slim cafe labels.
options.risk: Finding Chatime is slower than today’s single table unless you already know its status — the failure you named.

options.label: Stacked box wall
options.thesis: Every cafe is a box end in a wall you pull open.
options.viewport: A wall of stacked cafe end-labels; pull one to edit.
options.case: Thousands of cafes cannot live as a wall of boxes without burying scan speed.
options.kept: The ledger row as an end-label: name, status, origin.
options.risk: Looks like merch storage, not a publishing desk.

options.label: Coupon wallet
options.thesis: Each cafe is a coupon you validate or VOID.
options.viewport: A book of cafe coupons, one listing per stub.
options.case: A coupon book cannot show eighty names as fast as a ledger.
options.kept: Unpublish as a cancel stamp instead of a competing outline button.
options.risk: Travel-ephemera theater on a daily ops desk.

options.label: One-up feed
options.thesis: One cafe owns the screen; the next is a snap away.
options.viewport: A single cafe filling the viewport.
options.case: One-up viewing fails find-and-scan, the job of this desk.
options.kept: Pending count in nav as what is next, not a feed.
